title: 70,000 Veils Before the Muhammadan Presence
body:
Allah Allah Dastoor ya RijaalAllah.
(Mawlana Shaykh stands up)
Stand up. We must stand up for our Lord's praising.
Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar
Allahu Akbar wa ajjal wa `azham Rabbuna jalla wa `ala
Whole praisings and whole glory for the Lord of Creation, Allah Almighty. O our Lord! Forgive us. O our
Lord! Blessing us, O our Lord! Let us to understand something and to follow, as we gave to You our oath that
we are Your servants. Let us to be always Your servants, not follow anyone else and also we are giving our
highest salutes and greetings and honoring to the Seal of Prophets, most beloved servant of Allah Almighty in
His Divine Presence and His absolute deputy of Allah Almighty. Everything must give their salutes for the
deputy of our Lord Allah Almighty.
One king must be. May be only one deputy, can't be two. And for Allah Almighty He has only one deputy.
From pre-Eternal up to Eternal, can't be changed. Therefore, whole greetings, whole honoring, whole

glorifying and most high respects to that one. And for his honor Allah Almighty is creating whole Creation
from pre-Eternal up to Eternal. And for his honor, Allah Almighty, He is not in need to be with anyone, but
His deputy can't be alone. He is creature; that is Creator. Creator has no need for anything, but creature...
Therefore to be uns, familiarity for His deputy, absolute deputy. Must be. Therefore, He created whole
Creation for the honor of Muhammad (s)!!
(Mawlana Shaykh sits) Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah
Peace be upon him. Whole greetings and glorifying that belongs to Creation just granted to him, and he is
giving. He is an ocean that no one can understand his distance or his ocean's limits. Unlimited, also, for
unlimited One. Absolute Unlimited One, His deputy had been granted also on his level, unlimited Creation.
Creation, Allah Almighty granting always to him. That is a very fine point that may be understood only
through the highest level of friends of the Prophet (s).
Dastoor. Astaghfirullah, astaghfirullah, astaghfirullah, astaghfirullah.
And according to high command of Allah Almighty. because there is high command, higher command,
highest command! Highest command, only One! Ya Sayyidee, ya RasulAllah, countless salutes, countless
honoring, and countless glory for you, from Allah Almighty to you. Our greetings or glorifying going to be like
an atom or less through an endless Glory Ocean when Allah Almighty is granting to him. Where are you,
Salafi ulema?! Where are you, Wahhabi people?! You can't carry to say, one ummah, "As-salaatu wa 'ssalaamu `alayka yaa RasulAllah!"? You are not ashaming to say, "Haraam!"? But you are on a level that is
going to be level of animals. And animals, they are not accepting them because animals are giving their honor
to the Seal of Prophets (s). May Allah give us a good understanding. Understanding is a light granted from
Allah Almighty to His most honored and glorified one in His Divine Presence.
Therefore, I am ashaming to say "servant" because on that level, king can't be with a servant. Sultan, how can
he be sitting with his servant? No, can't be sitting with his servant. No! Must be granted such a highness and
honor or glory that he may be in Divine Presence to speak to Him and He speaks to him. 'Ajaib (strange),
people thinking that what they are learning is something. What is that? What you are learning ? If not
learning such a point, that is very fine point, can't enter anyone with his physical being, even with their
spirituality.

Once Sultan ul 'Arifin, Abu Yazid he was saying, "Once coming to me to approach from Haqiqatu 'lMuhammadiyah, salawaat. I asked and answer coming, 'You can't be, you can't do that.'" Even though he was
saying, "I intended to approach," his approach was just cut. "Just an opening coming to me, I am looking that
Haqiqatu 'l-Muhammadiyah (s) surrounded by 70,000 oceans from noor." Protection from common
creation, veiled Haqiqatu 'l-Muhammadiyah, veiled for everyone and for every creation, including Jibraa'eel
(a), Mikaa'eel (a), Asraa'feel (a), `Azra'eel (a) and Hamalatu 'l-`Arsh (angels who carry the `Arsh) and all
mala'ikah. Veiled, because if one opening, coming now. One curtain, if open. Abu Yazid asking to move
towards first veil, and coming a heavenly announcement saying, "O Abu Yazid, qif (stop)! If one step more,
you should be burnt and it is impossible to come to existence once again." This 70,000 veils towards
Creation, towards creatures, veiled from Haqiqatu 'l-Muhammadiyah.
(Mawlana Shaykh stands) Alfu salaat, alfu salaam. We are saying nothing for your honor, forgive us.
(Mawlana Shaykh sits) Allah Allah.
Therefore, towards Creation. And also 70,000 for Divine Presence, it is also. He was veiled not to approach
more than this, at least limit of his Lord, his Creator, Allah Almighty (swt). (Mawlana Shaykh stands, then
sits) Those veils not like veils that are between Noor Muhammadi (s) and Creation, no. Each veil 70,000 to
70,000 for protection. He is Allah Almighty. (Mawlana Shaykh stands) Allahu akbar wa lillahi 'l-hamd! Ya
Rabbuna! (Mawlana Shaykh sits) Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah. La ilaaha illa-Llaah (Mawlana Shaykh
stands) Sayyidina Muhammadun Rasoolullah (s). (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
Oooohhhh. We are losing a big chance, perhaps the biggest chance through this life. And people going to be
through an ocean, never knowing its beginning or ending. They are not going to, each fish asking to be an
ocean. Therefore, a fish, when it is through an ocean is opening its mouth. Not like this, open..
One wali was asking to another, "Why fish making this?"
Second one saying, "You are asking some question that you are not knowing?"
"Yes sir, I am knowing but I am asking to make it, through maqamat taqriq." (someone suggests
"realisation") More than this.
Second one's level was higher; therefore, he was saying, "I am understanding something but your

understanding is over mine."
And he was saying, "Its intention, opening its mouth, is to swallow whole ocean. Asking to swallow whole
ocean." That means, it is asking to be ocean. If it is swallowing, going to be ocean!
Fish teaching you, O Man! O heedless Mankind! Look at everything with wisdom eyes. That fish is asking to
reach whole ocean, to take it. And you are never taking any care to reach more noor from heavenly lights. And
always you are happy to be through darkness of sewage channels. Get out, O Mankind! Get out and look!
Where are you? What is up?! When you are getting out, look around at where you are and how are you going
to keep yourself through sewage channels? Mankind is on zero point, just falling through technologia,
through Antichrist. They are coming down, down, down. And those dajjals, antichrists, calling them, "Come
down, come down, you should find deepest points. You should find treasures. Come, come, come." Because
treasures just hidden from common people under earth; earth is covering. Therefore, saying, "Come down,
come down, come down and see what is for you." And saying to them, Shaytan's teaching saying to them,
"Look at Qaroon (note: a wealthy and greedy oppressor, cousin of Sayyidina Musa [a]). Don't believe that he
is under heavenly anger. No." Because he was so harees, eager to find treasures. Therefore, the Lord of
Heavens is sending him down to look, to reach more treasures. Shaytan making that happen in a way that
people are not taking any lesson from that one's final position. Saying, "No, no, no, he was collecting whole
treasures on earth and now the Lord of Moses sending him down to look for more treasures. Because under
your feet, countless treasures. Therefore, he had been granted to reach, under earth, treasures."
O People! Come and listen. Come and give your minds for understanding. Such an announcement just
reaching through our century because the Last Day is approaching. Behind door. Just reached, behind door
waiting a new opening. That was the reason. And, people, that small fish asking to reach whole ocean,
teaching people, "Look I am running to take more and more from this ocean." And you, O Man, that you have
been granted a chance for reaching heavenly treasures, why you are not taking care? You think that what
Shaytan saying for Qaroon, it is a real announcement for you? No! It is that Shaytan is cheating, asking to
cheat people not to give any desire to reach heavenly treasures, making their eyes only on earth and under
earth. Look and take your lesson from small fish asking to reach. It can't reach, but you, O Man, O Man, you
have a characteristic or you have an attribute from your Lord that you never going to be full. Always you are
going to be hungry, and asking more, "Hal min mazeed? (Is there no more?) O our Lord, hal min mazeed?"

"Take My servant, more and more endless."
Huuuuuuu Allahu akbar wa lillahi 'l-hamd!
O People! Sharpen your understanding a little bit. Through holiness peoples' advisings, a little bit time give
for your Lord. You should be happy when you are leaving this imitated life. It is not a real life here. That is
imitated life. You can reach to real life behind of spiritual people. According to your spiritual levels you may
reach and follow the Seal of Prophets (s). You should reach to such an oceans that whole oceans going to be
like an atom. Allahu akbar. Allahu akbaru 'l-akbar.
O People! Listen. This is a 20 minutes or half an hour association. What we are saying, so weak and so simple
things. But reality's glory, when you are reaching Glory Oceans you should find such a beauty, such an honor,
such a lightening you can't imagine and you should run hal min mazeed. "No more, O our Lord!" Giving.
"Take, take, take, take." Therefore, who is reaching Paradise, he is never getting full. Hunger, but hunger in
Paradise not like our animal being's hunger. No! No. No. It is one chance given to people to come here and we
are so lucky ones that we have been brought from Unknown Oceans on this planet. And the Lord of Heavens
asking to grant us. Grant us as through holy words of prophets, particularly holy words of the Seal of
Prophets Sayyidina Muhammad (s). (Mawlana Shaykh stands, then sits)
Allah Almighty saying, "These people on this planet, that when they have been granted some more things
from na'im ul dunya, favors of this life, , they are saying, "Oh our Lord's karam, generosity," and He is saying,
"O My servants, yet you have not reached dar ul karamati (abode of generosity). You have not reached yet the
Paradise that I granted to you forever. Dar ul karamati that I am giving, giving, giving. My generosity you
should find it, you should know it, you should taste it. You should enjoy it when you are coming to My dar ul
karamati, generosity through My karam." Generosity now here, no, nothing. You should find there.
Therefore, Allah Almighty, when His servants coming through His Generosity Oceans, generosity dominions,
you should see, you should taste, you should be enlightened, you should be honored, you should be enjoying
endlessly. "Here nothing," saying Allah Almighty. "Therefore, don't be cheated for a very short life on this
planet. I am inviting you to dar ul karamati, to My endless generosity Paradises, Jannatu na'im, you should
find that there."

As-salaamu `alaykum, O our listeners. We are not beginning yet but time is over. Yet I am not speaking to
you to say as-salaamu `alaykum and yet I am not saying a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani 'r-rajeem
because that power from takbir and salute to the Prophet (s) making Sadanas, Shaytan to escape and that
means a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani 'r-rajeem when coming so many real Power Oceans opening one
spot, giving to me such a power as a bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem going give to you and we are saying
bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem.
May Allah forgive us. Huuuuuuu. O our Lord, forgive us. We are heedless people, we are ignorant people, we
are idiot ones if we are not understanding and thinking. O Baba di Roma, Pope of Rome! And where is
cardinals? Where is Christian holy ones? Where are you, Chief Rabbi and other rabbis? If you are saying I am
saying something wrong, say what is true. You say what is true, I shall listen. If not, listen. That is something
from heavens to make people to leave to kill each other, to be suitable for dressing honor of deputy,
"deputyness" in the Divine Presence.
O People! Try to prepare yourself. But we are now 24 hours, slaves for Shaytan, slaves for dunya. It is not true
what technology teaching us, to run away from our Lord's Divine Presence. Technology is a trap from
Shaytan to make the sons of Children of Adam to go with him to hells. Don't obey Shaytan but try to obey
prophets, holy ones of the Lord of Heavens. May Allah forgive us.
Dome, dome, dome, dome 3x
Your forgiveness, O our Lord. Send us who can teach us truth, send us true ones whom they are knowing
what is truth and let them to carry us to truths, to guide ourselves on truth. You are able for everything. We
are weak ones. We need such special servants to be with us, for guiding us to real Reality.
Fatihah. (Mawlana hums a bit)
Last night we were laughing too much, tonight making you to think about something. Allah Almighty if
asking to make His servants happy, may do and they are laughing. If He is asking to make them sad, they are
crying. May Allah forgive us.
(45 minutes)

(Mawlana smiles) They know. We don't know. Subhaanallah. Thank you O Allah Almighty. Thanks to Allah
(Mawlana makes sajdah) Allahu akbar
Shukr yaa Rabbi. Amaan yaa Rabbi 3x
(325 viewers on livestream)
It is a working day, people are busy with dunya. Allah makes us to wake up. Wake up! Slowly east and west,
north to south millions hearing now. Important, awliyahs also taking now and hearing. Welcome to you.
Subhanallah
